Job Description Python Developer

Python DeveloperLocation: Mumbai / Gurugram

Experience: 5+ Years


Job Summary

  1. 5+ years of Python Programming experience.
  2. PERL understanding. (to convert some PERL code to Python. It can be as it is or with modification)
  3. Able to understand Sybase and SQL pointers
  4. In DB concepts program controls and SQL joins and filtering is important.
  5. Should be able to understand, use and modify stored procedures.
  6. Having worked on Ansible as an automation tool will be a plus.

Areas that specifically important to us are:

  • Testing, including writing unit and integration tests.
  • Debugging skills, including debugging scripts on the command line in production environments.
  • Independent thinking: solving problems with minimal supervision
  • Linux command line skills
  • Some understanding of Perl: at the minimum, some ability to read the code and understand what its doing to migrate it to Python.
